前言

多元智能理论是著名心理学家霍华德·加德纳博士在1983年提出的，他认为：“人类的智能是多元化的，每个孩子都是潜在的天才儿童，只是拥有的智能优势组合不同。”

语言表达智能
Linguistic Intelligence

运用语言表达思想，或运用书面文字传达信息的能力。语言智能高的孩子，适合从事作家、演说家、编辑、记者等职业。

数学逻辑智能
Logical-Mathematical intelligence

运用数字和推理的能力。数学逻辑智能高的孩子，适合从事数学家、科学家、财会、IT、程序员等职业。

肢体运动智能
Body-Kinesthetic intelligence

善于运用整个身体来表达想法和感觉，能够用双手灵巧地生产或改造事物。肢体运动智能高的孩子，适合从事运动员、舞蹈家、雕塑家、工匠等职业。

音乐智能
Musical Intelligence

对节奏、音调、旋律或音色具有敏感性，能够辨别、改变和表达音乐的能力。音乐智能高的孩子，适合从事歌手、指挥、作曲家、音乐家、钢琴师等职业。

视觉空间智能
Spatial Intelligence

对色彩、线条、形状、空间具有敏感性，并能够将其呈现出来的能力。视觉空间智能高的孩子，适合从事导游、设计师、建筑师、摄影师、画家等职业。

人际交往智能
Interpersonal intelligence

能够辨别人与人之间关系的暗示并及时做出适当反应的能力。人际交往智能高的孩子，适合从事政治、公关、销售等职业。

自我感知智能
Intrapersonal intelligence

了解自己内在情绪、意向和动机，能够自律、自知和自省的能力。自我感知智能高的孩子，适合从事心理辅导等职业。

自然认知智能
Naturalist intelligence

对自然中的植物、动物、矿物、天文等有浓厚的兴趣，并具有敏锐的观察和辨认能力。自然认知智能高的孩子，适合从事生物学家、地质学家、天文学家等职业。
page_text_en:
Preface

The theory of multiple intelligences was proposed by renowned psychologist Howard Gardner in 1983. He believed: "Human intelligence is diverse; every child is a potential genius, differing only in the combination of their intelligent strengths."

Linguistic Intelligence

The ability to express thoughts through language or convey information through written words. Children with high linguistic intelligence are suitable for careers such as writers, orators, editors, and journalists.

Logical-Mathematical Intelligence

The ability to use numbers and reasoning. Children with high logical-mathematical intelligence are suitable for careers such as mathematicians, scientists, accountants, IT professionals, and programmers.

Body-Kinesthetic Intelligence

The ability to express ideas and feelings using the whole body, and to skillfully produce or modify objects with hands. Children with high body-kinesthetic intelligence are suitable for careers such as athletes, dancers, sculptors, and craftsmen.

Musical Intelligence

Sensitivity to rhythm, pitch, melody, or timbre, and the ability to distinguish, alter, and express music. Children with high musical intelligence are suitable for careers such as singers, conductors, composers, musicians, and pianists.

Spatial Intelligence

Sensitivity to color, lines, shapes, and space, and the ability to represent them. Children with high spatial intelligence are suitable for careers such as tour guides, designers, architects, photographers, and painters.

Interpersonal Intelligence

The ability to recognize cues in interpersonal relationships and respond appropriately. Children with high interpersonal intelligence are suitable for careers such as politics, public relations, and sales.

Intrapersonal Intelligence

Understanding one's inner emotions, intentions, and motivations, and the ability to self-regulate, self-awareness, and self-reflection. Children with high intrapersonal intelligence are suitable for careers such as psychological counseling.

Naturalist Intelligence

A strong interest in plants, animals, minerals, astronomy, and other natural elements, along with keen observation and identification skills. Children with high naturalist intelligence are suitable for careers such as biologists, geologists, and astronomers.
summary_zh: 本页为绘本《波波的小伙伴》的前言部分，介绍了霍华德·加德纳的多元智能理论，并通过图文并茂的方式，列举了语言、数学逻辑、肢体运动、音乐、视觉空间、人际交往、自我感知和自然认知等八种智能类型及其对应的职业发展方向。

真果果达套《多元智能早教绘本系列》针对0~3岁宝宝编写，将多元智能理论中的六项智能融入六个故事中，用绘本的形式，帮助家长发现孩子的优势智能，扬长补短，让孩子能够多元化发展。

我叫波波，今天是我第一天去幼儿园，一想到要跟妈妈说再见，自己留在这里，我就开始害怕了。但是这里有好多小朋友和玩具，好像也挺有趣的，我得勇敢些才行，就像小恐龙一样！
page_text_en:
The 'True Fruit Early Education Picture Book Series' is designed for babies aged 0-3, integrating six intelligences from the theory of multiple intelligences into six stories. Through picture books, it helps parents discover their child's strengths, play to their strengths and improve weaknesses, enabling children to develop in a diversified way.

I'm Bobo. Today is my first day at kindergarten. I start to feel scared when I think about saying goodbye to Mom and staying here alone. But there are so many kids and toys here, and it seems quite fun. I need to be brave, just like a little dinosaur!
summary_zh: 本页左侧介绍了《多元智能早教绘本系列》的编写目的和内容，右侧通过波波的内心独白，展现了他第一天上幼儿园时既害怕又想勇敢面对的心理活动。

swing together?

Okay, I'm
Bobo, I'll help you

to play with her, but I'm a bit shy.

page_text_ocr_zh: 我们的老师很温柔，我特别喜欢她。上课的时候，老师问：“哪个小朋友会读这个字？”我把手举得高高的，但是老师看了看我，却叫了另外一个小朋友。
page_text_en: Our teacher is very gentle, and I really like her. During class, the teacher asked, 'Which child can read this character?' I raised my hand high, but the teacher looked at me and called on another child instead.
summary_zh: 波波在课堂上积极举手回答问题，但老师却叫了别的小朋友，他感到有些失落。

title_zh: 早教绘本-波波的小伙伴

page_text_ocr_zh:
我觉得有些委屈：老师没有叫我，是不是不喜欢我了？
我把心里的想法告诉老师。原来老师并没有不喜欢我，
还夸我很聪明，下节课我还要举手！
page_text_en:
I felt a bit upset: The teacher didn't call on me. Does that mean she doesn't like me?
I told the teacher what I was thinking. It turned out she didn't dislike me at all—
she even praised me for being smart! I'll raise my hand again next class!
summary_zh: 波波因老师未叫他回答问题而感到委屈，向老师倾诉后，得知老师并未不喜欢他，反而夸他聪明，他因此重拾信心，决定下节课继续举手。

我喜欢幼儿园的一切，除了捣蛋鬼龙龙。他把我和小朵好不容易搭出来的积木城堡推翻了，还经常欺负别的小朋友。
但是龙龙的个子和力气都比我大，所以一看到他就躲得远远的。
page_text_en:
I like everything about kindergarten, except for the troublemaker Longlong. He knocked over the block castle that Xiao Duo and I worked so hard to build, and he often bullies other children.
But Longlong is taller and stronger than me, so I always run away when I see him.
summary_zh: 波波在幼儿园里喜欢大部分活动，但害怕欺负人的龙龙，因为龙龙力气大且经常推倒积木城堡、欺负同学，波波因此选择躲开他。

“呜呜呜……”我听到玩具屋里有哭声，原来是龙龙躲在里面哭鼻子。

没想到这个捣蛋鬼也会哭，平时都是他把别的小朋友弄哭。龙龙说：“刚才我是想跟你道歉的，对不起……”
page_text_en:
"Wah wah wah..." I heard crying from inside the toy house. It was Longlong, hiding inside and crying.

I never thought this troublemaker would cry. Usually, it's him making other kids cry. Longlong said, "I was trying to apologize to you just now. I'm sorry..."
summary_zh: 波波听到玩具屋里传来哭声，发现平时欺负人的龙龙正在哭泣。龙龙向波波道歉，表示自己刚才想道歉但没说出口。

page_text_ocr_zh: “波波，你能原谅我真好呀，我也想跟别的小朋友道歉，但是他们都害怕我，看到我就躲开了，你能帮我吗？”我想了想，点点头，龙龙高兴地跳了起来。
page_text_en: "Bobo, it's so good that you can forgive me. I also want to apologize to other children, but they are all afraid of me. They run away when they see me. Can you help me?" I thought for a moment, nodded, and Longlong jumped up happily.
summary_zh: 龙龙向波波道歉，请求帮助他向其他小朋友道歉，波波同意后，龙龙高兴地跳了起来。

title_zh: 早教绘本-波波的小伙伴
source_file: 早教绘本-波波的小伙伴（0-3岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh: 怎么才能帮助龙龙和别的小朋友和好呢？有了！我打算这个周末邀请他们来我家开派对，这样龙龙就有机会说出自己的真实想法，大家就会原谅他了。
page_text_en: How can I help Longlong make up with the other children? I've got it! I plan to invite them to a party at my house this weekend. That way, Longlong will have a chance to share his true feelings, and everyone will forgive him.
summary_zh: 波波在画画时思考如何帮助龙龙与其他小朋友和好，决定周末邀请大家到自己家开派对，让龙龙有机会表达真实想法，从而获得原谅。

title_zh: 早教绘本-波波的小伙伴

page_text_ocr_zh: 开派对要做很多准备，我自己可忙不过来，去请爸爸和妈妈来帮忙吧！他们知道了龙龙的事情，很高兴地答应了我的请求。妈妈做了很多好吃的，爸爸帮我把房间布置得特别漂亮。
page_text_en: Having a party requires a lot of preparation. I can't manage it all by myself, so I asked Dad and Mom for help! They knew about Longlong's situation and happily agreed to my request. Mom made lots of delicious food, and Dad helped me decorate the room beautifully.
summary_zh: 波波为帮助龙龙与其他小朋友和好，决定举办派对，并请爸爸妈妈帮忙准备食物和布置房间。
